accepted.s:
With reference to the Women's ODI World Cup 2025, consider the following statements:
1. India and Sri Lanka co-hosted the tournament.
2. It was India's fourth time as host.
3. Deepti Sharma was the Player of the Tournament.
4. Shafali Verma was the Player of the Match in the final.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Shafali Verma was the Player of the Match in the final, while Deepti Sharma was the Player of the Tournament; the statement incorrectly describes Shafali as the final's Player of the Match only in the context given here? Actually the final award was Shafali Verma, so statement 4 is also correct.
accepted.tq: Test host, edition history and individual awards together; verify every statement before selecting the code.
accepted.sec: Cricket and football - World Cups, IPL/WPL, Durand/Santosh  [APPSC]
